findings.summary: Trivial computed predicate can be deleted.
findings.consequence: The component carries an extra reactive binding for a pure one-field prop comparison, so readers must trace `isStartPage` before seeing that the shell only branches on `page === "start"`.
findings.evidence: Line 8 defines `computed(() => props.page === "start")`; the same component template already reads `page` directly for active-link state, and all direct callers pass fixed declared variants (`page="start"`, `page="pjäser"`, or `:page="kind"` where `kind` is `"om" | "kringtexter"`). No policy, normalization, async boundary, or shared API is enforced by the computed wrapper.
findings.recommendation: Delete `isStartPage` and use `page === "start"` directly in the four template branches that currently consume it.
verification: Inspected relevant Dramawebben visual/behavior tests and CSS selectors that rely on startpage/subpage rendering.
Used read-only inspection only; no tests were run because the packet lists no tests and the issue is a local simplification, not a suspected behavioral failure.
